key_insight: AI is positioned as a unifying tool to understand, predict, and mitigate instability in 3D all-inorganic perovskites by linking mechanism discovery with engineering design.
engineering_relevance: For CsPbX3 devices, AI can help prioritize stability diagnostics, accelerate reliability prediction, and guide more robust material and process choices under thermal, chemical, optical, and electrical stress.
method: Consequence, reliability modeling, and engineering optimization
evidence_signal: The review highlights that instability studies are hindered by multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification, motivating AI-driven analysis.
watch_item: Current AI approaches are limited by inconsistent datasets and protocols, which can reduce interpretability and transferability across different perovskite domains.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
